page.title: Log in
page.verificationSentBody: If {{email}} can have an account here, a message is on its way to it. Follow the link in it, and then log in.
page.forgotPasswordBody: Type the email you log in with, and we will send you a link for choosing a new password.
page.resetSentBody: If {{email}} has an account here, a link for choosing a new password is on its way to it.

errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts, please try again later
errors.unavailable: Log in is unavailable right now, please try again later
errors.invalid-email: That does not look like an email address
errors.passwords-do-not-match: The two passwords are not the same
errors.email-already-in-use: That email already has an account
errors.email-not-verified: Your email has not been confirmed yet. We have sent you the link again.
